[general]
name=Grid Tools
qgisMinimumVersion=3.34
description=Atlas sheet grids sized from paper and scale, sheet count estimates, and renumbering after you move sheets by hand.
version=0.2.0
author=Joeywoody124
email=joeywoody124@gmail.com

about=The sheet layout half of Field Kit, packaged on its own. Builds a numbered atlas sheet grid from a coverage polygon, a paper size and an engineering scale; estimates how many sheets a site takes across a ladder of scales without creating anything; and rebuilds sheet numbering, grid references and neighbour links from position after you have moved sheets around by hand. Installs alongside the full Field Kit plugin without clashing.

tracker=https://github.com/Joeywoody124/Bulk_Vector_Clip/issues
repository=https://github.com/Joeywoody124/Bulk_Vector_Clip
homepage=https://github.com/Joeywoody124/Bulk_Vector_Clip

tags=processing,atlas,layout,grid,sheets,civil

category=Plugins
experimental=True
deprecated=False
hasProcessingProvider=yes
